5676.title: Configured ACP agents cannot declare or discover fork support
5676.rootCauseOneLine: Custom agent configuration forces fork none, rejects an explicit fork field, and excludes configured agents from probing.
5676.proposedFix: Add a validated opt-in fork configuration and carry it into registration; preserve narrowing-only capability policy. No autopilot PR because this changes a public configuration schema.
5676.caveats: Real plugin reproduced in two clean source checkouts with SDK transport fixtures. External agent and Channels runtime were not exercised. Complete test and selected diagnostics are inline per public reports policy.
